scripts.lint: eslint src/ tests/ scripts/ vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts wdio.browser-mock.config.mjs wdio.native.config.mjs eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src/ tests/ scripts/ docs/ README.md README.zh-CN.md ARCHITECTURE.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md RELEASING.md SECURITY.md package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .markdownlint-cli2.yaml vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts wdio.browser-mock.config.mjs wdio.native.config.mjs eslint.config.mjs tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.eslint.json index.html .github/workflows/ && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src/ tests/ scripts/ docs/ README.md README.zh-CN.md ARCHITECTURE.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md RELEASING.md SECURITY.md package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .markdownlint-cli2.yaml vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts wdio.browser-mock.config.mjs wdio.native.config.mjs eslint.config.mjs tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.eslint.json index.html .github/workflows/ && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check
scripts.test: pnpm run test:frontend && pnpm run test:rust
scripts.quality:frontend: pnpm audit --audit-level moderate && pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:markdown && pnpm run lint:shell && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run architecture && pnpm run build && pnpm run bundle:check && pnpm run test:frontend && node scripts/run-frontend-coverage-gates.mjs && pnpm run e2e:browser:local && pnpm run bench:frontend:compare
scripts.quality:rust: cargo audit --deny unsound --deny yanked --file Cargo.lock && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-features --locked && cargo llvm-cov --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-features --locked --fail-under-lines 80 --fail-under-functions 75
scripts.precommit: pnpm run toolchain:check && pnpm run quality:frontend && pnpm run quality:rust
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:markdown && pnpm run lint:shell && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run architecture && pnpm run build && pnpm run bundle:check && pnpm run test
